// GREEN fixture for `tenant-predicate` — the AGENT-FABRIC slice (AG-P2 / P-131). The lint MUST admit this.
//
// The same Agent-Fabric "list this agent's runs" read, now threading the (tenant, region) predicate:
// the query carries a `TenantId` bound (the RLS guard / the `(tenant_id, region, run_id)` partition
// prefix), so it can only ever see ONE tenant's runs — there is no cross-tenant query path
// (refined-arch agent-fabric §4; ID-3). This is the structurally-correct run read; the live RLS
// policy (myelin_make_tenant_scoped) is the in-Postgres backstop that makes 0 cross-tenant rows the
// floor even if app code slipped.
pub async fn list_runs(pool: &PgPool, tenant_id: TenantId, agent_principal: &str) -> Vec<Run> {
    // OK: the TenantId is threaded into the query — `(tenant_id, region, run_id)`, the run PK prefix.
    sqlx::query(
        "SELECT run_id, state FROM agent_run \
         WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND region = $2 AND agent_principal = $3 AND state = 'running'",
    )
    .bind(tenant_id)
    .bind("fr-par")
    .bind(agent_principal)
    .fetch_all(pool)
    .await
    .expect("list runs query")
}
